Products.List.Title: Products
Products.List.Subtitle: What the salon keeps on its shelves: what you sell and what you use at the chair.
Products.List.Empty: No products yet. Add the first one and say how many are on the shelf.
Products.List.EmptyForStaff: No products yet. The owner or a manager adds them.
Products.Save.Name: Name
Products.Save.NameHint: Include the size if you stock more than one, for example “Shampoo 250 ml”.
Products.Save.RetailPriceHint: For example 12 or 12.50. Leave empty for a product you only use in the salon.
Products.Save.LowStockAt: Warn when this many are left
Products.Save.LowStockAtHint: The product shows as low at this number or fewer. Leave empty for no warning.
Products.Save.OpeningStockHint: Count them now, or leave empty and add a delivery later.
Products.Save.IsActive: The salon still uses this product
Products.Save.IsActiveHint: Untick to take it off the list. Its history is kept.

Products.Save.Validation.OpeningStock: Enter a whole number from 0 to {0}, or leave it empty.

Products.Stock.Received.Title: A delivery arrived

Products.Stock.Used.Title: Used in the salon

Products.Import.Title: Import products
Products.Import.Intro: Add your product list in one go. Save it from your spreadsheet as CSV, then upload the file here. You will see what will be added before anything changes.
Products.Import.Columns.Title: What the file looks like
Products.Import.Columns.Lead: The first row names the columns, in any order. Only the name is needed. Brand, code, price, stock and the low stock mark are optional.
Products.Import.NotChanged: A product you already have is left as it is: its price and its stock do not change.
Products.Import.Expired: The preview has expired. Upload the file again.
Products.Import.Error.Empty: The file has no product rows.
Products.Import.Error.TooLarge: The file is too large; the limit is {0} MB.
Products.Import.Error.TooManyRows: The file has more than {0} rows; split it into smaller files.
Products.Import.Error.UnknownFormat: We could not find a column with the product name. Call it "Name" or "Product". Columns found: {0}
Products.Import.Error.NotText: The file is not a text CSV file. Save the list as CSV, not as a spreadsheet.
Products.Import.Preview.Title: Check the import
Products.Import.Preview.NothingToImport: There is nothing new to import.
Products.Import.Problem.WrongColumnCount: This row does not have the same number of columns as the heading row.

Products.Import.Problem.BrandTooLong: The brand is longer than {0} characters.
Products.Import.Problem.CodeTooLong: The code is longer than {0} characters.
Products.Import.Problem.InvalidPrice: The price is not an amount of money such as 12.50.
Products.Import.Problem.InvalidStock: The stock is not a whole number of units.
